 6 die of dengue, 1,970 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 433 this year 
 Published : 2 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 2 November 2026, 19:45
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least six dengue patients died and 1,970 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today.
 Of the deaths, three were reported in Dhaka division, two in Mymensingh division and one in Sylhet division, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the new deaths and cases, the total number of deaths rose to 433 and cases 138,899.
 Currently, 6,017 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at different hospitals across the country.
